`basic_test_ppt_file.ppt` is a real OLE PowerPoint test fixture from Apache POI:
https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/trunk/test-data/slideshow/basic_test_ppt_file.ppt

Apache License 2.0: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

It is used to verify real legacy text extraction, not as student course content.

`converted-slide.pptx` is a synthetic ZIP/XML fixture for converter dispatch tests.
